why.owner: Allowed: the server owner may do everything
why.open: Allowed: open permissions let everyone who can talk do this

intro: See what someone may do, and which rule decides each thing. Pick a member to start from their roles, then add or remove roles to see what would change. Or check a set of roles on its own.
introBoard: See what someone may do on this board, and which rule decides each thing. Pick a member to start from their roles, then add or remove roles to see what would change. Or check a set of roles on its own.
whatIf: Showing {name} with different roles than they have.
start: Search for a member above, or choose Roles only.

notes.serverWide: Server-wide: what applies on every board that has no rules of its own.
notes.customOff: Custom permissions are off, so the defaults apply: what each Discord permission allows.
notes.open: Open permissions are on: everyone who can view channels and send messages may work with boards.
notes.notMember: {name} is not in the server, so only rules for them personally count.
